description.text: V Starter Deck: Transformation, released at the end of November 2022: a random ready-to-play 60-card deck with damage counters and a rule book, each holding one Pokémon VMAX or Pokémon VSTAR, in more than 500 different deck combinations. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
